args.title: Retail Returns: Combined Summary (Saltmarsh 2026)
args.body:
- Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, highlighting the scale of the returns challenge in retail logistics.
- Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by roughly a fifth (~20%), showing the value of centralizing returns processing.
- Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin, making fast turnaround critical to returns economics.
